body:
> ℹ️ No critical issues. One rough edge inline, plus a note on the description. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed the whole relayout of the recording detail page after Export v3: the new title row, the destinations panel, the copies grid with Drag, and the i18n and backlog doc updates. - **Title row**: `← Library`, the renamable title and the master tag now share the top row. The title wrapper is `flex: 1; min-width: 0`, so the h1's existing ellipsis kicks in only at the tag. - **Metadata and actions**: the meta line adds the probed resolution and an "N copies" count. The action row holds only buttons and wraps. "Export a copy" replaces "Send to…". - **Probe on every local recording**: `useSourceProbe` no longer depends on `heavy || showCard`. - **"Saved to your Library" notice**: it shows only for `fromRecording` and is dismissed per `location.key`. `masterNote` waits until it is gone. - **`DestinationsPanel`** (new): one equal card per `DESTINATION_IDS` entry, with a `planCopy` estimate and an upload/light tone. It opens Prepare via `preparePath`. "Not now" hides it for this visit. It replaces `WhereIsThisGoingStrip`, which is deleted. - **`MasterCopiesPanel`**: copies are two to a row. A copy's picture size is derived from the source probe and its preset. The running row gets a progress bar, and the header gets "Open in Export →". A Drag handle reuses `startFileDrag`, the same way `export-status-cards.tsx` does. The empty state is gone because the caller only renders the panel when there is something to list. - **Heavy banner**: it now shows whenever the destinations panel doesn't, including a heavy master that has copies. ### ℹ️ The description says seven destinations, but the code and the doc say six Under "Notes for review", the PR description says "Seven destinations, as in the design. Since the export-screen merge, Email is its own card". But `DESTINATION_IDS` in `features/prepare/destinations.ts` has six entries (`youtube`, `vertical`, `square`, `github`, `chat`, `archive`). The tests only exercise those six, with Email folded into "Slack · Discord · Email", and the updated `prepare-screen.md` says "the code has six". QA following the description will look for a seventh card that isn't there.
Technical details ````markdown # PR description disagrees with `DESTINATION_IDS` ## Affected sites - PR description, "Notes for review": the first bullet claims seven destinations, with Email as its own card - apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:36: `DESTINATION_IDS` has six ids - apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/prepare-screen.md:114: says "the code has six" (consistent with the code) ## Required outcome - The description and the backlog doc agree with what `DESTINATION_IDS` actually lists ````
